column2: POS ya resitora · ku buntu iteka ryose
Abakiriya benshi saa sita. Nta interineti. Nta kibazo.
Khaynjo icunga icyumba cyo kuriramo, igikoni na kontwari ku bikoresho usanzwe ufite — kuva ku meza kugeza mu gikoni kugeza ku nyemezabuguzi, hari interineti cyangwa idahari.
Android kuri Google Play uyu munsi · verisiyo za Windows na Linux ziraje.
Ibitabo byawe biguma ku bikoresho byawe
Icyumba cyawe cyo kuriramo mu kureba rimwe
Kanda ku meza kugira ngo ukurikire intambwe zayo zose kuva abashyitsi bicaye kugeza bishyuye. Amabara n’amagambo ni bimwe n’ibyo muri porogaramu — kandi imeza yongera kuboneka ari uko yishyuwe gusa.

Ifunguro rimwe ryamamaye rya buri gihugu — izina mu Cyongereza, izina mu nyandiko yabo, n’ifunguro mu Cyongereza. Shyira ayo magambo ku rutonde rwawe rw’ibiryo. Isi ikomeza kwigendera; hagarika cyangwa ushakishe igihe ushaka kureba.
Shakisha igihugu cyangwa ifunguro — urugero India, biryani, Japan
Ifunguro rimwe ryamamaye kuri buri gihugu — urugendo ruzenguruka isi yose.
Imeza imwe, kuva mu ntangiriro kugeza ku iherezo.
Reba imeza kuva abashyitsi bicaye kugeza Byishyuwe — intambwe n’amabara bimwe n’ibyo abakozi bawe babona muri porogaramu.
Shyira imeza kuri Yafashwe abashyitsi bakimara kwicara. Ongeraho amafunguro, hitamo ingano, ongeraho inyongera, kandi wandike icyitonderwa cy’igikoni — aho ku meza.
Hitamo ingano imwe; ongeraho inyongera ushaka kugeza ku mupaka washyizeho.
Itike imwe kuri buri shami ry’igikoni
Ohereza komande maze buri shami ribone amafunguro yaryo gusa — afite nimero ya buri munsi, imeza, umukozi w’ameza n’ibyitonderwa byose. Nta giciro na kimwe: igikoni giteka, kontwari yishyuza.
Ohereza, maze itike icapirwe ku ishami rikwiye — nta muntu uyitwara.

Kuri ekarani y’igikoni amatike ava kuri Nshya → Birategurwa → Byateguwe ukanze rimwe. Amatike ya kera ahindura ibara agashyuha, “Ibyo guteka ubu” bibara buri funguro ritegereje, kandi amafunguro nyamukuru ashobora gutegereza kugeza ibyo gutangiriraho bigiye.

Amafaranga mu ntoki n’amafaranga yo gusubiza, UPI ifite amafaranga asanzwe ari muri QR, kwishyura igice, cyangwa ideni mu gitabo cy’amadeni cy’umukiriya. Gabanya ukurikije ikintu, intebe cyangwa mu buryo bungana. Imeza yongera kuboneka ari uko inyemezabuguzi yayo yishyuwe gusa.

Bara isanduku y’amafaranga uyigereranye n’amafaranga yo gutangiza, amafaranga mu ntoki yakiriwe, udushimwe n’amafaranga mu ntoki yasohotse — ibura cyangwa ikirenga birerekanwa. Capa urupapuro rw’igihe cy’akazi, hanyuma ufungure raporo y’umunsi ukurikije umukozi, ubwoko bwa komande, isaha n’ifunguro, hamwe n’ibyahagaritswe, amafunguro y’ubuntu n’udushimwe.
IBINDI BYOSE ICYUMBA CYO KURIRAMO GIKENERA
Impinduka ziba buri saa sita — zikorwa ku mugaragaro, hakabikwa uwabikoze, igihe n’impamvu.
Abashyitsi bahindura ameza — komande n’iminota yayo bijyana na bo. Ameza abiri, inyemezabuguzi imwe.
Hamwe n’impamvu, byatetswe cyangwa bitatetswe, n’uwabyemeje. Igikoni kibona urupapuro rw’ihagarikwa.
Ifunguro ry’ubuntu riguma ku nyemezabuguzi kuri ₹ 0, hamwe n’impamvu n’uwaryemeje.
Buri gikorwa cyemewe, cyemewe hakoreshejwe PIN y’umuyobozi, cyangwa ntikemewe — umuntu ku muntu.
Shakisha ukoresheje izina cyangwa kode ngufi, hamwe n’andi mazina mu rundi rurimi — “ptk” ibona Paneer tikka.
Igiciro kiri hejuru mu cyumba cya AC; intonde z’ibiryo bya mu gitondo n’ibiciro by’isaha y’igabanywa bikurikije isaha.
Kwishyura igice n’ideni bijya kuri konti y’umukiriya mu Bafatanyabikorwa, bikishyurwa nyuma.
Ibyagurishijwe ukurikije umukozi, ubwoko bwa komande, isaha n’ifunguro — hamwe n’urutonde rw’ibyahagaritswe, amafunguro y’ubuntu n’udushimwe.
Urutonde rwawe rw’ibiryo, rwiteguye mu minota mike.
Tegura kontwari yawe maze uhitemo urutonde rw’ibiryo rwo gutangiriraho rufite amafoto — hanyuma uhindure amazina, ibiciro na kode bibe ibyawe. Ni ubuntu kuyikura kuri khaynjo.com.
Urutonde rw’ibiryo rwo gutangiriraho rwa Khaynjo
Ibiryo byo ku isi — ibyo mu Buyapani, Megizike, Ubutaliyani, Ubuhinde, Tayilande n’ibindi — buri funguro n’ifoto yaryo.
Urutonde rw’ibiryo rwo gutangiriraho rwa kafe
Icyayi, ikawa, ibinyobwa bikonje, imigati n’utundi turyo — byiteguye kafe ifite kontwari.
Ububiko bwuzuye bw’amafoto rusange — hitamo ifoto ya buri funguro wongeraho.

Komande, amatike y’igikoni, inyemezabuguzi n’igitabo cy’umunsi biba ku bikoresho byawe. Iyo interineti ivuyeho hagati ya saa sita, nta kintu na kimwe muri resitora yawe kiyitegereza — kandi nta konti iwacu ugomba kwinjiramo.
Ubu nyine, hagati ya saa sita
Kontwari: yakira komande kandi yishyuza inyemezabuguzi
Igitabo cy’umunsi: buri nyemezabuguzi ibitswe kuri iki gikoresho
Tabuleti z’abayobozi b’abakozi b’ameza na ekarani y’igikoni: bikorana kuri Wi-Fi yawe
Ku buntu iteka ryose ku bikoresho byawe.
Ubushobozi bwa porogaramu si cyo tugurisha. Koresha Khaynjo yose ku bikoresho byawe nta kiguzi — nta kintu na kimwe gisaba ifatabuguzi kugira ngo gikoreshwe.
Icyumba cyo kuriramo, igikoni, inyemezabuguzi, gufunga umunsi, raporo — porogaramu yuzuye.
Nta kwishyuza kuri buri meza, umukozi w’ameza, komande cyangwa igikoresho.
Serivisi ya buri munsi ntikenera kwiyandikisha cyangwa interineti.
Igicu cya buri mwaka niba ukishaka

Steady ₹6 000 · Swift ₹14 000 · Priority ₹28 000 / umwaka hatarimo umusoro (umusoro mu gihe cyo kwishyura). Iyihariye ni igereranyagiciro — ishobora kuba munsi ya Steady cyangwa hejuru ya Priority. Khaynjo iri ku bikoresho byawe iguma ku buntu iteka ryose uko byagenda kose.
Bibazwa mbere ya serivisi ya mbere.

Oya. Komande, KOT, inyemezabuguzi n’igitabo cy’umunsi bikora nta interineti. Uyikenera rimwe gusa kugira ngo ukure porogaramu kuri interineti kandi, niba ubishaka, urutonde rw’ibiryo rwo gutangiriraho.
Ku gikoresho cyawe, mu iduka ryawe — si kuri seriveri zacu. Kora kopi z’ububiko uhereye muri Igenamiterere kandi uzibike aho ushaka hose.
Telefone na tabuleti za Android uyu munsi, kuri Google Play. Verisiyo za Windows na Linux ziri mu nzira.
Yego — kuri mashini zicapa zikoresha ubushyuhe washyize muri Igenamiterere → Amacapyi, itike imwe y’igikoni kuri buri shami.
Ese abakozi banjye bashobora gukoresha ururimi rwabo?
Yego. Ekarani ziboneka mu ndimi 115, Icyarabu n’Icyurudu kuva iburyo ujya ibumoso, kandi amazina y’amafunguro ashobora kugira andi mazina mu yindi nyandiko.
Nta kintu ku bikoresho byawe — buri kiranga, iteka ryose. Kumkaj Cloud y’ubushake ni iya buri mwaka: Steady / Swift / Priority (cyangwa igereranyagiciro ryihariye); fungura /shop kugira ngo ugure.
Koresha Khaynjo muri serivisi yawe ikurikira.
Ku buntu kuri Google Play. Urashaka kubanza kwerekwa? Twandikire kuri WhatsApp.
Porogaramu zo kwinjiza zizashyirwa hano buri imwe imaze gutsinda igerageza ryo kwinjizwa kuri mudasobwa nshya. Kugeza icyo gihe, saba kwerekwa kuri WhatsApp.
Umurongo wo kwerekwa wa WhatsApp uzafungura vuba. Ubutumwa bwawe buzaba: “{message}”.
Nta gihugu cyangwa ifunguro bihuye n’ibyo washakishije.
Gushakisha bihagarika urugendo; siba ibyo washakishije kugira ngo rukomeze, cyangwa rugume ruhagaze uko warusize.
Konti imwe y’urubuga na porogaramu — ifishi imwe waba uri mushya cyangwa ugarutse.
Tuzakoherereza umuyoboro wo kongera gushyiraho kuri imeri. Koresha aderesi imwe wiyandikishijeho.
Imeri yo kwinjira ukoresheje ijambo ry’ibanga
Huza uburyo butandukanye na konti imwe kugira ngo ushobore kugarura uburenganzira bwo kwinjira niba bumwe bunaniwe.
Amafatabuguzi y’igicu ya buri mwaka — umusoro wongerwaho mu gihe cyo kwishyura. Porogaramu yuzuye ya Khaynjo ku bikoresho byawe iguma ku buntu iteka ryose, nta matangazo.
Igitebo cyawe kirimo ubusa. Ongeramo Steady, Swift cyangwa Priority.
Kwishyura bikwinjiza muri Konti, hanyuma bigatangira kwishyura (igerageza ryigana cyangwa Paddle iyo imfunguzo zashyizweho).

Amafatabuguzi ya buri mwaka — irembo ryo kwishyura ryongeraho umusoro mu gihe cyo kwishyura. Gukoresha ku gikoresho cyawe biguma ku buntu iteka ryose. Iyihariye ni igereranyagiciro (ishobora kuba munsi ya Steady cyangwa hejuru ya Priority).
Koresha ijambo ry’ibanga rifite nibura inyuguti 6.
Imeri cyangwa ijambo ry’ibanga si byo.
Iyi domeni ntiyemerewe kuri Firebase Auth.
Wagerageje inshuro nyinshi cyane. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.
Koresha nimero ya telefone yuzuye ifite kode y’igihugu (urugero +91…).
Iyo kode ya SMS si yo cyangwa yararengeje igihe.
Nta konti ifite iyo imeri. Komeza kugira ngo uyifungure, cyangwa ukoreshe ubundi buryo.
Kubw’umutekano, ongera winjire, hanyuma wongere ugerageze iri hinduka.
Ubwo buryo bwo kwinjira busanzwe bukoreshwa n’indi konti.
Iyo imeri isanzwe ikoreshwa n’indi konti.
Ubwo buryo busanzwe buhujwe n’iyi konti.
Hasanzwe hariho konti ifite iyi imeri ikoresha ubundi buryo bwo kwinjira. Banza winjire ukoresheje ubwo buryo, hanyuma uhuze ubu buryo uhereye ku ipaji ya konti yawe.
Hindura ijambo ry’ibanga ryawe. Uzemeza ukoresheje irisanzwe.
Ongeraho ijambo ry’ibanga kugira ngo ushobore no kwinjira ukoresheje imeri (bifasha iyo utanga serivisi atabonetse).
Nta utanga serivisi yo kwishyura nyayo wafunguwe kuri API y’igicu (igerageza ryigana riri ku gikoresho cyawe gusa).
Ubwishyu bwakiriwe — ifatabuguzi ryawe ririmo kuvugururwa…
Kwishyura byafunzwe — nta bwishyu bwarangiye. Ifatabuguzi ryawe ntiryahindutse.

Nta na kimwe cyanditswe kugeza ubu
Konti yafunguwe. Reba imeri yawe kugira ngo uyemeze igihe ubonye umwanya.
Niba hari konti y’iyo imeri, umuyoboro wo kongera gushyiraho uri mu nzira. Reba agasanduku k’ubutumwa bwawe.

Sohoka wongere winjire, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.

Ijambo ry’ibanga ryongeweho. Ubu ushobora no kwinjira ukoresheje imeri.
